dialogues.jp: 『ん、ん、あ〜、テステス』
dialogues.en: "Mm, mm, ahh~, testing testing."
dialogues.text: "Mm, mm, ahh~, testing testing."

dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp:
『……ん？　あーあー、聞こえてんのかなぁ？
　ま、いっか』
dialogues.en:
"...Hm? Aaaahh, can people here this? Oh well, I'd give it a
try..."
dialogues.text:
"...Hm? Aaaahh, can people here this? Oh well, I'd give it a
try..."

dialogues.jp:
恐ろしくアバウトな言葉が、天井に設置された
スピーカーから聞こえてくる。
dialogues.en:
Slightly fearful words emnated from the speakers stationed
at the ceiling.
dialogues.text:
Slightly fearful words emnated from the speakers stationed
at the ceiling.

dialogues.jp: （……それに、どっかで聞いたような声だな？）
dialogues.en: "(...That voice sounds oddly familiar...)"
dialogues.text: "(...That voice sounds oddly familiar...)"

dialogues.jp:
『お兄ちゃん、聞こえる〜？　ボクと一緒に、
　ご飯食べようよ〜』
dialogues.en: "Onii-chan, can you hear me~? Let's each lunch together~"
dialogues.text: "Onii-chan, can you hear me~? Let's each lunch together~"

dialogues.jp: 『放送室で待ってるからね。お兄ちゃん♪』
dialogues.en: "I'd be waiting at the broadcasting room, onii-chan♪"
dialogues.text: "I'd be waiting at the broadcasting room, onii-chan♪"

dialogues.jp: ――プツッ
dialogues.en: --*zzzt*
dialogues.text: --*zzzt*

dialogues.jp:
何だかなあ。訳分からん妹が居るんだな。この
学園には。
dialogues.en: I didn't know someone had a sister in this school as well.
dialogues.text: I didn't know someone had a sister in this school as well.

dialogues.jp:
「さて、さっさと購買に行くか。パンがなくな
　る……」
dialogues.en:
"Anyway, I should hurry up. The bread will all be gone by
now..."
dialogues.text:
"Anyway, I should hurry up. The bread will all be gone by
now..."

dialogues.jp: 「大漁大漁」
dialogues.en: "Whoo, a big catch today."
dialogues.text: "Whoo, a big catch today."

dialogues.jp:
『あ〜……うにゃ、テステステスト〜……う〜
　ん、聞こえてるよねぇ？』
dialogues.en: "Ah~... unya, testing testing... mmm, can you hear me?"
dialogues.text: "Ah~... unya, testing testing... mmm, can you hear me?"

dialogues.jp: 「ん？　また？」
dialogues.en: "Huh? Again?"
dialogues.text: "Huh? Again?"

dialogues.jp: 『お兄ちゃん！』
dialogues.en: "Onii-chan!"
dialogues.text: "Onii-chan!"

dialogues.jp: 「まさか、さくら！？」
dialogues.en: "Don't tell me it's Sakura!?"
dialogues.text: "Don't tell me it's Sakura!?"

dialogues.jp: 『ボクとご飯食べるのそんなに嫌なの！？』
dialogues.en: "Do you dislike eating lunch with me that much!?"
dialogues.text: "Do you dislike eating lunch with me that much!?"

dialogues.jp:
『せっかく放送まで──あっ、せ、先生！？う、
　うにゃあっ！』
dialogues.en:
"It took so much effort to get to the broadcasting system to
-- ah, t, teacher? U, unyaaa!"
dialogues.text:
"It took so much effort to get to the broadcasting system to
-- ah, t, teacher? U, unyaaa!"

dialogues.jp: ――プツッ
dialogues.en: --*bzzt*
dialogues.text: --*bzzt*

dialogues.jp: 「……なんだかなぁ」
dialogues.en: "...What's that all about..."
dialogues.text: "...What's that all about..."

dialogues.jp:
しかしその後、何故か俺まで暦先生から怒られ
てしまった。
dialogues.en:
Yet, a while after, Koyomi-sensei was angry at me because of
that.
dialogues.text:
Yet, a while after, Koyomi-sensei was angry at me because of
that.

dialogues.jp: なんだかなぁ……。
dialogues.en: What's that all about...
dialogues.text: What's that all about...

dialogues.jp: ◆さくらから呼び出し◆
dialogues.en: ◆Sakura's Paging◆
dialogues.text: ◆Sakura's Paging◆

dialogues.jp:
スピーカーから、謎の声。お兄ちゃんと呼んで
いた。
dialogues.en:
From the speakers came an enigmatic voice, calling out for
her brother.
dialogues.text:
From the speakers came an enigmatic voice, calling out for
her brother.

dialogues.jp:
その正体はさくらで、実は俺の事を呼んでいた
らしい。一緒に昼食を取ろうとか何とか。
dialogues.en:
It was actually Sakura, trying to ask me to eat lunch with
her.
dialogues.text:
It was actually Sakura, trying to ask me to eat lunch with
her.

dialogues.jp:
全く、俺まで講師に怒られてしまったではない
か……。
dialogues.en:
And she somehow managed to get me in trouble with the
teachers as well...
dialogues.text:
And she somehow managed to get me in trouble with the
teachers as well...
